title: Azure KQL Log Analytics (mscs:kql / mscs:kql:stats) events
description: Field schema for the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Log Analytics KQL input. Field sets are entirely query-dependent -- properties here are the common/well-known columns Log Analytics tables typically carry, not a fixed contract; additionalProperties is true throughout.

kqlEvent.title: Azure KQL Log Analytics -- mscs:kql
kqlEvent.description: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Log Analytics KQL query result, sourcetype mscs:kql. All columns returned by the configured KQL query become top-level fields. Schema is entirely query-dependent.

TimeGenerated.description: Event generation time in the Log Analytics workspace (very common in most tables)

Type.description: Log Analytics table name that produced the row (e.g. SecurityEvent Heartbeat AzureActivity)

_ResourceId.description: Full ARM resource ID associated with the record

ResourceId.description: Resource ID (often same as or related to _ResourceId)

Computer.description: Computer / host name (common in agent-based tables)

SourceSystem.description: Source system that collected the data (e.g. OpsManager Azure Device)

_SubscriptionId.description: Subscription ID extracted from resource context

_ResourceGroup.description: Resource group extracted from resource context

_ItemId.description: Unique item identifier within the workspace

MG.description: Management group or workspace-related identifier when present

WorkspaceId / WorkspaceName.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier or name (add-on or query context)

Category.description: Log category when present in the source table

OperationName.description: Operation name when present (common in AzureActivity ActivityLog tables)

ResultType / ResultDescription.description: Result status and description when present

kqlStatsEvent.title: Azure KQL Log Analytics -- mscs:kql:stats
kqlStatsEvent.description: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Log Analytics KQL stats/aggregation query result, sourcetype mscs:kql:stats. All columns returned by the configured KQL query become top-level fields. Schema is entirely query-dependent. When using stats-style queries columns such as count dcount avg min max sum percentile etc. appear according to the KQL summarize/extend statements

TimeGenerated.description: Event generation time in the Log Analytics workspace (very common in most tables)

Type.description: Log Analytics table name that produced the row (e.g. SecurityEvent Heartbeat AzureActivity)

_ResourceId.description: Full ARM resource ID associated with the record

ResourceId.description: Resource ID (often same as or related to _ResourceId)

Computer.description: Computer / host name (common in agent-based tables)

SourceSystem.description: Source system that collected the data (e.g. OpsManager Azure Device)

_SubscriptionId.description: Subscription ID extracted from resource context

_ResourceGroup.description: Resource group extracted from resource context

_ItemId.description: Unique item identifier within the workspace

MG.description: Management group or workspace-related identifier when present

WorkspaceId / WorkspaceName.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier or name (add-on or query context)
